description.sub_name: 多媒體安全理論與實務
description.describe_ch: 本課程旨在提供多媒體安全技術的全面介紹，結合理論與實務應用，涵蓋數位版權保護、加密技術、數位浮水印、資訊隱藏及數位內容完整性驗證等關鍵主題。學生將學習多媒體資料(影像、三維模型、音訊、影片模型等)的保護方法，並深入了解相關的加密演算法與隱藏技術，掌握處理數位內容安全挑戰的能力。本課程強調實作，通過一系列實作與期末專題，學生將有機會應用所學技術來解決現實中的多媒體安全問題，並探索多媒體安全領域中的研究趨勢。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to provide a comprehensive introduction to multimedia security technologies, blending theory with practical applications. It covers key topics such as digital rights management, encryption techniques, digital watermarking, information hiding, and digital content integrity verification. Students will learn methods to protect multimedia data (including images, 3D models, audio, video models, etc.) and gain in-depth understanding of relevant encryption algorithms and concealment techniques, equipping them with the ability to address digital content security challenges. Emphasizing hands-on practice, the course offers a series of practical projects and a final capstone project, allowing students to apply the acquired skills to real-world multimedia security issues while exploring emerging research trends in the field.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
1. 介紹上課與成績評量方式並完成學生分組
2. 多媒體安全背景介紹
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
1. Introduction to the course and grading system; completion of student group assignments.
2. Background overview of multimedia security.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
1. 黑白影像、灰階影像、彩色影像與高動態範圍影像格式介紹
2. 三維模型格式介紹
3. 音訊與影片格式介紹
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
1. Introduction to image formats: black-and-white, grayscale, color, and high dynamic range (HDR) images.
2. Overview of 3D model formats.
3. Introduction to audio and video formats.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
1. 資訊隱藏技術
2. 數位浮水印技術
3. 完整性驗證技術
4. 秘密分享技術
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
1. Information hiding techniques.
2. Digital watermarking techniques.
3. Integrity verification techniques.
4. Secret sharing techniques.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
1. 最低有效位元取代
2. 最佳像素調整程序
3. 最低有效位元匹配與像素差值技術
4. 可回復式資訊隱藏技術
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
1. Least Significant Bit (LSB) substitution.
2. Optimal Pixel Adjustment Process (OPAP).
3. LSB matching and pixel difference techniques.
4. Reversible data hiding techniques.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
1. 植基於影像內插的可回復式資訊隱藏技術
2. 無失真、可適應性、可回復式資訊隱藏與完整性驗證技術
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
1. Reversible information hiding techniques based on image interpolation.
2. Lossless, adaptive, and reversible information hiding and integrity verification techniques.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading:
1. 適用於三維模型的資訊隱藏技術
2. 適用於三維模型的完整性驗證技術
3. 適用於三維模型的可回復式資訊隱藏技術
weeklyScds.tpd_reading_en:
1. Information hiding techniques for 3D models.
2. Integrity verification techniques for 3D models.
3. Reversible data hiding techniques for 3D models.

weeklyScds.tpd_reading: 適用於加密三維模型的多媒體安全技術

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
課堂討論參與 (30%)
課堂參與成績包括學生在課堂上的互動、討論表現、課堂練習的完成度與品質、課堂作業的準時繳交以及出席狀況。學生需積極參與課堂活動，展示出對課程內容的理解與思考。
書面報告 (30%)
書面報告為期末專題規劃，學生需繳交一份完整的專題計畫書，包含研究背景、目標、方法設計及預期成果。評分將根據報告的邏輯性、創新性、內容的深入程度以及表達的清晰性。
期末專題 (40%)
期末專題包含專題成果的展示與口頭報告，學生需將書面計畫轉化為實際成果，並在課堂上進行展示與說明。評分將根據專題的完成度、技術難度、創新性、實際應用價值以及報告的表達技巧與應對能力進行綜合評估。
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:
Grading Criteria
Class Participation (30%)
Class participation includes student interaction, performance in discussions, completion and quality of in-class exercises, timely submission of assignments, and attendance. Students are expected to actively engage in class activities, demonstrating understanding and critical thinking about course content.
Written Report (30%)
The written report serves as the final project proposal. Students must submit a comprehensive project plan, detailing the research background, objectives, methodological design, and expected outcomes. Grading will be based on the report's logical structure, innovation, depth of content, and clarity of expression.
Final Project (40%)
The final project involves the presentation and demonstration of project outcomes. Students must transform their written proposal into practical results and present them in class. Evaluation will consider the project’s completeness, technical difficulty, innovation, practical value, presentation skills, and ability to address questions.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Academic Integrity Guidelines
This course places a high value on academic integrity and expects all students to adhere to ethical principles, maintaining honesty in their learning and research activities. The following rules apply:
  1. Honest Completion of Assignments and Reports
    All coursework, written reports, and final projects must be the original work of the student or group. Plagiarism, copying the work of others, or unauthorized use of external materials is strictly prohibited. Proper citations must be provided when referencing external works or data.
  2. Prohibition of Improper Collaboration
    Students must collaborate within the boundaries of the course rules. Tasks designated as individual work must not involve collaboration or sharing of answers with others.
  3. No Cheating
    The final project report and presentation must accurately represent the student’s research and implementation efforts. Any form of academic dishonesty, including data fabrication, will result in severe consequences.
